name: azure-sandbox-hello-world
description: A paced, deterministic demo that exercises MCP, shell tools, Git, repository reads, and Agentics artifact publishing.

content.thinking: First I will inspect the live Vibecast session so the demonstration proves that MCP tools are connected.

content.text: I’ll begin by checking the live broadcast and sandbox session.

content.thinking: The session is live. I will inspect the assigned job and working tree before producing this station's deliverable.

content.text: The MCP connection is healthy. Now I’m inspecting the job context and repository state.

input.command: sleep 2 && curl -fsS "$AGENTICS_BASE_URL/api/owners/$AGENTICS_OWNER/projects/$AGENTICS_PROJECT_NAME/runs" > /tmp/agentics-runs.json && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const runs=require("/tmp/agentics-runs.json"); const run=runs.find(r=>r.jobs?.includes(process.env.AGENTICS_JOB_ID)); if(!run) throw new Error("Current run not found"); const j={id:process.env.AGENTICS_JOB_ID,agentDefinition:run.agentDefinition}; fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/agentics-job.json",JSON.stringify(j)); console.log(JSON.stringify({job:j.id,station:j.agentDefinition.columnId,task:j.agentDefinition.taskId},null,2))' && git status --short
input.description: Inspect the station job and repository

content.thinking: I will create a station-specific proof file, update the shared result, and commit all expected changes so the automatic Git guard can pass.

content.text: Creating the station deliverable and committing it to the shared project repository.

input.command:
sleep 2 && station=$(node -p 'require("/tmp/agentics-job.json").agentDefinition.columnId') && mkdir -p demo-artifacts && printf '# Azure Sandbox station

Station: %s
Status: completed
Runtime: isolated sandbox + devcontainer
' "$station" > "demo-artifacts/$station.md" && printf 'agentics-azure-sandboxes: ok
execution: sandbox-devcontainer
' > RESULT.md && git add RESULT.md demo-artifacts .devcontainer/Dockerfile .devcontainer/devcontainer.json && (git diff --cached --quiet || git -c user.name='Agentics Testbench' -c user.email='testbench@agentics.local' commit -m "demo($station): complete sandbox station")
input.description: Create and commit the station deliverable

content.thinking: The repository is committed. I will read the shared result back as visible verification.

content.text: The commit is complete. I’m reading the acceptance result back from the workspace.

content.thinking: The result is correct. I will now publish a durable delivery artifact to the Agentics project.

content.text: Publishing a delivery artifact with the station result and execution details.

input.command: sleep 2 && node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const j=require("/tmp/agentics-job.json"); const station=j.agentDefinition.columnId; fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/delivery-artifact.json",JSON.stringify({type:"delivery",name:`Azure Sandbox demo — ${station}`,description:`Deterministic output from the ${station} station`,taskId:j.agentDefinition.taskId,assemblyLineId:j.agentDefinition.assemblyLineId,streamId:process.env.VIBECAST_SESSION_ID,data:{summary:`The ${station} station ran inside its own Azure Container Apps Sandbox, used the Vibecast MCP server, modified the shared Git repository, and published this artifact.`,station,status:"passed",runtime:"azure-sandbox-devcontainer",testResults:{passed:1,failed:0,details:"Deterministic acceptance fixture completed"}}}))' && curl -fsS -X POST "$AGENTICS_BASE_URL/api/owners/$AGENTICS_OWNER/projects/$AGENTICS_PROJECT_NAME/artifacts" -H "Authorization: Bearer $AGENTICS_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @/tmp/delivery-artifact.json

content.text: The station deliverable is committed and its Agentics artifact is published. Completing this station successfully.

input.message: Completed the sandbox station, committed its proof file, and published a delivery artifact.

content.text: The station is complete and the delivery artifact has been published.
